ModMetaData.name: Vanilla Combat Overhaul
ModMetaData.author: cruesoe
ModMetaData.description:
Depth for vanilla combat, without replacing it.
Every feature is toggled individually in mod settings. Mechanics that can be stats are stats, so apparel, hediffs, genes and other mods can influence them.
Shipped: melee parry and counter, directional damage and height targeting, leftover armor, advanced accuracy, evasion, firing arc, bullet and arrow wound shapes, visible tracers, and Vanilla Combat Reloaded's apparel coverage patches.
Still on the roadmap: suppression, ammo, sidearms, and loadouts.
